text: THE INVARIANT ALGORITHM

It checks the rules
that must always be true
textPreview: It checks the rules | that must always be true

text: An invariant is a simple security rule for the application.
textPreview: An invariant is a simple security rule for the application.

text: User data
A user should only see their own data
textPreview: A user should only see their own data

text: Money actions
A refund or withdrawal should follow the right checks
textPreview: A refund or withdrawal should follow the right checks

text: Secrets
Passwords and keys should not sit in source code
textPreview: Passwords and keys should not sit in source code

text: INVARIANT follows the code path and checks whether the rule is being followed.
textPreview: INVARIANT follows the code path and checks whether the rule is being followed.

text: For every possible issue, the tool records the evidence and what a human still needs to check.
textPreview: For every possible issue, the tool records the evidence and what a human still needs to check.

text:
Source: Invaria Engineering & Product Blueprint, sections 2 and 3; docs/INVARIANT_ENGINE.md. Screenshot: live Invaria decision ledger.

Talk track: INVARIANT is the product's decision engine. It starts with a rule, follows the relevant code path, and checks whether the code can prove that the rule is protected. If it cannot, it gives the reviewer the evidence instead of pretending that the issue is already confirmed.
